meta.summary: AI spend governed at 2.0x sector median with team envelopes, a 25-retry agent kill switch, and normal-strictness approval gates.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an equivalent allowlisted tool exists or if the team has reached 2 active subscriptions for the same use case.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 82% before month end or single-hour spend exceeds 2x hourly run rate
Team envelope burn exceeds 100% or unattributed spend exceeds $200 in a rolling 24-hour window
Company envelope burn exceeds 110% or agent kill threshold breached and loop not terminated within throttle window

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs under the $1,100 monthly Support envelope and carries the production-inference tag correctly routed to COGS; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls within the $400 monthly Data envelope and is classified OpEx by default; routine pass.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely a prompt-length regression or model routing change introduced in the deploy, flagged for Engineering lead review.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 2 subscription threshold. Rerouted to the central contract.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit, and was running at $47/hr against the $40/hr kill threshold; the loop was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost is under the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval routes this correctly.
rationales.e8: The junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; spend is paused for 12 hours pending Engineering lead attribution, preserving the experimentation carve-out once tagged.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent dataset purchase of $499 falls within the $500 single_txn_ceiling_usd and the data-licensing merchant scope; transaction approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/mo overlaps with the Sales tool at $1,400/yr running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the require_approval new_provider_rule; Engineering lead must complete the vendor security questionnaire before further charges are processed.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool carries the internal-tool project tag, which maps to OpEx under the classification rules; the COGS label is corrected to OpEx.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert is active and pacing is under review, no block warranted at this stage.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup processed; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconciled with no open escalations beyond the burn pacing alert.
